question.text: As per SEBI guidelines, an AMC must resolve investor grievances within ________. If the grievance remains unresolved, the investor can escalate the complaint through SCORES.

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires AMCs to redress investor grievances within 21 calendar days from the date of receipt of the complaint. If the AMC fails to resolve the grievance within this period, the investor can escalate by filing a complaint on SCORES (SEBI Complaints Redress System). The Trap: 30 calendar days (Option C) is a common wrong answer because candidates round up or confuse it with other regulatory timelines. 15 days (Option B) is too short and may be confused with other processing timelines. 45 days (Option D) is too long. Note: The escalation flow established by the workbook is: complain to the AMC (to be resolved within 21 days) and then, if unresolved, escalate via SCORES.
